assumptions.A-ARITH-05: Wei/Gwei and basis-point arithmetic is interpreted over non-negative bounded integer domains; Solidity overflow checks are represented as rejected states.
assumptions.A-DEP-02: The beacon deposit sink consumes exactly one 32 ETH unit for each modeled initial validator deposit and exactly the modeled allocation amount for top-ups; deposit-root, BLS, dummy-signature behavior, minimum top-up checks, and SSZ correctness are outside this lane.
assumptions.A-EXT-01: External contract callbacks and sinks mutate no unlisted SRv3 accounting state in the focused economic model.
assumptions.A-GOV-14: Governance role authorization, calldata authorship, module contract registration, address/interface validation, and event semantics for module-management updates are outside this lane; the model checks the invoked SRv3 fee, share, config, status, and add-module validation/update loops.
assumptions.A-ID-04: Module IDs are unique and accepted report arrays align with router module order.
assumptions.A-LIDO-06: LIDO.withdrawDepositableEther makes exactly the requested depositable amount available to the router and does not consume withdrawal-reserved ETH.
assumptions.A-MOD-07: IStakingModule.obtainDepositData returns the modeled number of deposit pubkeys and mutates no router accounting fields other than through the explicit SRv3 transition.
assumptions.A-MOD-08: IStakingModule.getStakingModuleSummary returns the deposited-validator count used by SRv3 exited-count validation; node-operator internals and warning-event conditions are outside this lane.
assumptions.A-MOD-10: IStakingModuleV2.allocateDeposits returns the modeled top-up allocation array and mutates no router accounting fields except through the explicit SRv3 transition; key ownership and module internals are outside this lane.
assumptions.A-MOD-11: IStakingModuleV2.getTotalModuleStake returns the modeled total module stake used to compute WC02 allocation equivalents.
assumptions.A-MOD-13: IStakingModule.onRewardsMinted callback effects, low-level revert bytes, event emission, and gas-estimation behavior are outside this lane; the model checks only the SRLib loop guards that decide whether a callback may be attempted.
assumptions.A-ORC-03: Accepted reports have already passed off-chain oracle validation; the modeled SRv3 transition still checks full module-array length, router-order module IDs, and the SRv3 Gwei amount range before applying module balances.
assumptions.A-REWARD-09: Reward fee arithmetic stays within Solidity precision and cast domains, including the final totalFee <= FEE_PRECISION_POINTS assertion.
assumptions.A-ALLOC-12: The external MinFirstAllocationStrategy and governance target-limit admissibility satisfy their documented contracts; this lane models the SRv3-owned current-allocation and capacity array construction before that strategy runs.
